market_snapshot.notes: Wednesday recap: S&P 500 -1.11% (7,718.94), Nasdaq -1.88% (26,692.87), Dow -0.09% (51,621.48) - biggest one-day drop since July after hot September CPI

headlines.headline: TSMC posted a sixth straight record quarter - Q3 net profit up 68.7% to NT$763.1B, beating the NT$746.3B consensus; revenue NT$1.49T. Q4 revenue guided to $52.3-54.3B with full-year 2026 USD revenue growth of 44%, but struck a cautious note for 2027 on macro uncertainty.
headlines.why_it_matters: Record quarter and strong AI demand signal, but the cautious 2027 comment is feeding the same AI-spending durability worries already hitting chip stocks - TSM fell 1.7% overnight.

headlines.headline: ASML reported Q3 revenue of EUR 11.66B (up 55.2% y/y) and net profit of EUR 4.96B (more than doubled), and raised full-year revenue guidance to EUR 44-45B; CEO said customers are already discussing equipment orders for 2029-2030.
headlines.why_it_matters: Bullish read-through for AI capex stretching years out - cuts against the AI-bubble narrative, though ASML shares still fell 3.9% Wednesday in the sector-wide rout.

headlines.headline: AI-credit rout deepens in premarket: Nasdaq 100 futures down 1.26%, S&P 500 futures down 0.35% (Dow futures +0.39%). CoreWeave fell another 4.5% after a 15% drop; Oracle -2%, Nvidia -1.3%, Micron -4%, AMD -1.9%.
headlines.why_it_matters: Rate-hike repricing is squeezing leveraged AI-infrastructure names hardest - this is the same CoreWeave/Oracle bond-stress trade from Wednesday extending overnight.

headlines.headline: September CPI came in hot: +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y (3.6% expected; August 3.4%); core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y, both above forecast. Gasoline +9.1% m/m. Traders now price ~60% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike.
headlines.why_it_matters: Hotter inflation is pulling forward rate-hike expectations, which lifts borrowing costs for the debt-heavy AI buildout - the macro trigger behind Wednesday's tech selloff.

Whether the AI-credit selloff stabilizes or spreads from CoreWeave/Oracle to hyperscaler names

analysis: The dominant theme is a hot-CPI-meets-AI-credit double hit: Wednesday's 3.7% y/y inflation reading repriced rate-hike odds (~60% chance of a quarter-point hike), and that is landing directly on the leveraged AI-infrastructure trade - CoreWeave's distressed bonds (~15% yield), Gartner's neocloud warning, Oracle's 9% drop. Fresh overnight, TSMC's record quarter and ASML's raised guidance are the bullish counter-signal: actual AI chip demand is still beating expectations and capex is being planned out to 2029-2030, yet both stocks fell anyway as the market de-rates rather than re-examines demand. Megacaps were broadly weak Wednesday (META -3.27%, NVDA -3.16%, TSLA -2.15%; only AAPL +0.50% while crossing $5T), and Nasdaq 100 futures are down another 1.26% premarket while Dow futures are positive - a clear growth-vs-value split. Signal vs noise: the credit stress at CoreWeave is real but company-specific for now; watch hyperscaler capex comments and GPU rental pricing for evidence of actual demand decay. The 10-year at 5.19% and VIX at 16.83 confirm the risk-off tone.
